scope.summary: Implement the shared Cloth+BodyKit final-render AOV/canvas outputs, region/spot render, TailorRenderJobV1 queue, retry/priority/cancellation, output templates, comparison, history, and Render Library, integrated with the existing Handshake Photo Studio capability and backed by artifact manifests and no-context operation.
acceptance_criteria: AOV/canvas definitions, crop/spot regions, queue priority, dependencies, retries, output templates, formats/color spaces, compare/history, artifact hashes, and source scene versions are explicit.

TailorRenderJobV1 is registered as `hsk.tailor.render_job@1` with the exact minimum structure in 13.30 [TAI-ACT-008]: job/project/scene/camera ids and authority versions; renderer/backend/device/qualification profile; body/garment/material/groom/pose/animation refs; resolution/sampling/frame/AOV/canvas/color/output settings; queue priority/owner/lease; state/progress/checkpoint/retry/cancellation; output artifacts; diagnostics; action/event/correlation ids; and timestamps.

Cloth and BodyKit renders use the same TailorRenderJobV1 queue, AOV vocabulary, checkpoints, output templates, comparison/history, Render Library indexing, ArtifactStore handles, and EventLedger lineage required by 13.32 [TAI-BKP-008..009].

Queue, comparison, history, output, and navigation integrate with the existing Handshake Photo Studio capability; no Tailor-local duplicate Photo Studio product, queue, library, or mutable artifact authority is permitted.
Queue work inherits scheduler leases/backpressure/cancellation/orphan recovery; retry-failed-only and app restart cannot duplicate completed artifacts or leave survivor processes.
Backend and Argus tests cover multi-agent enqueue/reorder, stale scenes, partial AOVs, disk error, cancellation, device loss, retry, comparison, and direct-load Render Library navigation.
scope.risk_if_missed: A renderer without AOVs, spot render, queue, recovery, and library cannot support professional Daz-class production.

surfaces: Shared Cloth and BodyKit Tailor render queue and Render Library
Existing Handshake Photo Studio queue, comparison, history, and output integration

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Render stills, animation, and AOVs > Queue, cancel, resume, retry, compare, and recover shared Cloth/BodyKit renders

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

risks: A renderer without AOVs, spot render, queue, recovery, and library cannot support professional Daz-class production.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.
